After reading, you'll have all you need to increase engagement, drive more revenue, and build a compelling website experience for your users.</p><p><br><strong>Key Stats About HTML5 Games </strong></p><figure class="kg-card kg-image-card kg-card-hascaption"><img src="/img/blog/content/images/2025/05/Revenue-and-Users-Updated.jpg" class="kg-image" alt="HTML5 game stats" loading="lazy" width="1920" height="1080" srcset="/img/blog/content/images/size/w600/2025/05/Revenue-and-Users-Updated.jpg?w=800&q=50?w=600&q=50 600w, /img/blog/content/images/size/w1000/2025/05/Revenue-and-Users-Updated.jpg?w=1000&q=50 1000w, /img/blog/content/images/size/w1600/2025/05/Revenue-and-Users-Updated.jpg?w=1600&q=50 1600w, /img/blog/content/images/2025/05/Revenue-and-Users-Updated.jpg?w=1920&q=50 1920w" sizes="(min-width: 720px) 720px"><figcaption><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Source - Statista and Gamezop Business</span></figcaption></figure><h3 id="embed-html5-games-using-an-iframe"><strong>Embed HTML5 Games using an Iframe </strong></h3><p>The <iframe> tag is the main tool of game embedding. .catch(error => console.error('Error:', error));</code></pre><figcaption><p><span style="white-space: pre-wrap;">Example: Fetching game catalog</span></p></figcaption></figure><h3 id="embed-html5-games-using-javascript-sdks"><strong>Embed HTML5 Games using JavaScript SDKs</strong></h3><p>Game distribution platforms quite often, will give you JavaScript SDKs (Software Development Kits) that make integration more powerful and flexible.</p><p>How it usually follows:</p><ol><li>Include the provider's SDK in your website.</li><li>Initialize the SDK with your publisher credentials.</li><li>Use the SDK's methods to load and display games.</li><li>Take advantage of additional features like analytics, leaderboards, or achievements.</li></ol><p>SDKs typically offer more features than simple <iframe> embedding, like game preloading, seamless transitions between games, and detailed analytics.</p><figure class="kg-card kg-code-card"><pre><code class="language-javascript"><script src="https://cdn.gameprovider.com/sdk.js"></script>
